MZMCHAR-音频设置.title: Audio
MZMCHAR-ENABLE_CUSTOM_BGM.title: Custom BGM in Non-Boss Combat
MZMCHAR-ENABLE_CUSTOM_BGM.hover.title: Custom BGM in Non-Boss Combat
MZMCHAR-ENABLE_CUSTOM_BGM.hover.desc: Replace vanilla combat music with custom tracks in regular combats.
MZMCHAR-ENABLE_CUSTOM_BGM_BOSS.title: Custom BGM in Boss Combat
MZMCHAR-ENABLE_CUSTOM_BGM_BOSS.hover.des: Replace vanilla boss music with custom tracks during boss fights.
MZMCHAR-USE_BGM_FOR_ALL_CHARACTERS.title: Use This Mod’s BGM for All Characters
MZMCHAR-USE_BGM_FOR_ALL_CHARACTERS.hover: Use This Mod’s BGM for All Characters

By default the combat BGM is only replaced when Mutsumi is in the run. Turn this on to use this mod’s BGM with any character (the two switches above still apply). BGM is local-only and does not affect multiplayer.
MZMCHAR-卡面设置.title: Card Art
MZMCHAR-CARD_ART_STYLE.title: Card Art Style
MZMCHAR-CARD_ART_STYLE.hover.title: Card Art Style
MZMCHAR-CARD_ART_STYLE.hover.desc: Switch the illustration style of every card. Cards already on the table won't refresh instantly; restart the game for it to fully apply.
